title: All Saints' Day + Blue Chant, Vol. I

instagram.caption:
Happy All Saints' Day. 🕯

Today the Church celebrates every saint in heaven: the famous ones in stained glass, and the countless others whose names only God remembers. That second crowd is why we're here, one forgotten saint each morning, on their feast day.

And a gift for the day: Blue Chant, Volume I, is out. Nine original pieces of Gregorian chant played as jazz, for prayer, study and the quiet hours. Made with AI tools. Listen at allholysaints.com/music, or the full hour on our YouTube channel, @AllHolySaints.

All holy men and women, saints of God, pray for us.

#AllSaintsDay #AllHolySaints #CatholicSaints #GregorianChant #SacredMusic
